 JUDGMENT 1.
The A. P. Nagar Police have charge sheeted the accused no.1 to 3 for the offences punishable under Sections U/s.498(A) r/w sec.34 of I.P.C. and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. The brief facts of the prosecution case is as follows:-
On 25.10.2021 marriage of the accused no.1 and complainant was solemnized in terms of Hindu customs and after the marriage the accused in furtherance of their common intention started demanding a site from the complainant as a dowry and further after the marriage, the accused in furtherance of their common intention subjected the complainant to mental and physical cruelty by demanding site as dowry and on 22.05.2022 at about 5.00 p.m., the accused assaulted the CW1 by demanding dowry by subjecting her to mental and physical cruelty.

On the first information given by the CW1, FIR came to be registered and after completion of investigation,
charge sheet came to be filed against the accused for the above said offences.
3. After taking cognizance, this court has complied Section 207 of Cr.P.C. by supplying charge sheet materials to the accused.
The Charges read over and explained to the accused no.1 to 3 and they have not pleaded guilty of alleged offences and claimed to be tried.

4. The Prosecution in order to prove the case, examined the P.W.1 and got marked Ex.P1 and 2.
5.
The 313 Statement of accused no.1 to 3 dispensed with for having not found any incriminating materials against them.
6. I heard learned APP and learned counsel appearing for the accused.

7. The points that arose for my consideration are:
:: P O I N T S ::

Point No.1 : Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that, on 25.10.2021 marriage of the accused no.1 and complainant was solemnized in terms of Hindu customs and after the marriage the accused in furtherance of their common intention started demanding a site from the complainant as a dowry and there by committed offence punishable under section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act?
Point No.2.

Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that, after the marriage, the accused in furtherance of their common intention subjected the complainant to mental and physical cruelty by demanding site as dowry and on 22.05.2022 at about 5.00 p.m., the accused assaulted the Annapoorneshwarinagar Police Station vs Harshavardhan N on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114471526/
2 CW1 by demanding dowry by subjecting her to mental and physical cruelty and thereby the accused has committed offence punishable under section 498A r/w sec.34 of IPC?

sentences.text:
Point No.3. What order?
8. After going through the records and hearing the learned APP and learned counsel for the accused.

I answer the above points as under :
 Point No.1 & 2 : In the Negative  Point No.3 : As per final order,
 for the following:
 REASONS 9. Point No.1 & 2 : As the facts involved in these points are common, in order to avoid repetition of facts, they are taken together for consideration.
10. The prosecution in order to prove its case has examined the complainant as PW1 and got marked complaint at Ex.P1, panchanama at Ex.P2.
11.

The prosecution in order to prove the case has examined the complainant as P.W1 and PW1 in her evidence she has deposed that, accused is her husband and accused no.2 is her mother-in-law and accused no.3 is the sister of the accused no.1 and she deposed that, there was a family dispute between the complainant and accused and she does not know the contents of complaint and panchanama and she has not supported the prosecution case and she is totally turned hostile to the prosecution case and she is treated as hostile witness and she was cross-examined by the learned App by suggesting that, after the marriage the accused in furtherance of their common intention subjected the complainant to mental and physical cruelty demanding site as a dowry and therefore she has given complaint as per Ex.P1 and panchanama was conducted in the place shown by her as per Ex.P2.
But all these suggestions were denied by PW1 and nothing worthy was elicited in the course of the cross-examination in favour of the prosecution.

12. The complainant is the material witness and she is none other than the wife of the accused and daughter-in-law of the accused no.2 and complainant herself has not supported the prosecution case and there are no incriminating materials found against the accused, hence, 313 statement of the accused no.1 to 3 dispensed with for having not found any incriminating materials against the accused.
Hence accused no.1 to 3 are entitled for the benefit of doubt and they are entitled to be Acquitted.
Hence, with the above observations, I hold point No.1 and 2 in the NEGATIVE.

13. Point No.3: For the reasons stated and discussion made above, I proceed to pass the following ;
ORDER
The accused no.1 to 3 are ACQUITTED U/s 248(1) of Cr.P.C. for the offences punishable U/s 498(A) r/w sec.34 of I.P.C. and section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds executed by accused no.1 to 3 shall be continued for a period of six months.
